title: Commands as messages through bridge
description: Menu commands are routed via bridge to avoid cross-frame coupling
body: The title bar's File and Edit menus, from this side. The shell's menu bar cannot reach into this app — File Viewer runs in an iframe and the shell must not import its hooks or poke its DOM. So a menu item is a *message*: the shell posts a transport-B `command` to the active frame and this module answers it.
